questions.question: Why does David extol the LORD in Psalm 30?
options: Because God made him wealthy and great
Because God gave him victory in war
Because God granted him a long life
Because God drew him up and healed him
questions.answer: Because God drew him up and healed him

questions.question: What well-known contrast does David make?
options: Sorrow endures for a season, but glory shall last on forever
Trouble rises up like the sea, but God stills the raging storm
The wicked flourish for a single day, but very soon they all wither
Weeping may tarry for the night, but joy comes with the morning
questions.answer: Weeping may tarry for the night, but joy comes with the morning

questions.question: David says God turned his mourning into dancing.
Weeping may tarry for the night, but _____ comes with the morning.
You have turned for me my mourning into _____.
